import torch, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'src'))
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from evaluate import (evaluate_perplexity, evaluate_true_dense,
                      vanilla_teal_global_masks, _collect_swiglu_magnitudes,
                      _global_topk_masks, _print_mask_stats, teal_global_masks,
                      collect_layer_inputs)
from data_utils import get_eval_dataset
from predictor import PredictorWrapper

device = torch.device('cuda:0')
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/llama-3.1-8b')
if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
    tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    '/root/autodl-tmp/models/llama-3.1-8b', dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    device_map={'': device}, attn_implementation='sdpa')
model.eval()

wt2 = get_eval_dataset('wikitext2', tokenizer, 2048)
calib_ids = torch.stack([wt2[i]['input_ids'] for i in range(min(32, len(wt2)))]).to(device)
print(f'Loaded {len(wt2)} eval, {calib_ids.shape[0]} calib sequences')

n_eval = 50
ppl_dense = evaluate_true_dense(model, wt2[:n_eval], device)
print(f'Dense PPL: {ppl_dense:.2f}')

# 1) Vanilla TEAL at 70%
print('\n--- Vanilla TEAL 70% ---')
avg_mag = _collect_swiglu_magnitudes(model, calib_ids)
masks = vanilla_teal_global_masks(model, calib_ids, 0.7, avg_mag=avg_mag)
sp = _print_mask_stats('Vanilla-TEAL-70', masks)
ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, wt2[:n_eval], device, masks)
print(f'Vanilla TEAL 70% PPL: {ppl:.2f}')

# 2) Predictor sigmoid scoring
print('\n--- Predictor TEAL 70% (sigmoid) ---')
wrapper = PredictorWrapper(model, bottleneck_size=128)
ckpt = torch.load('checkpoints/kl_sparsity70_s42/predictor_kl_normalized.pt',
                   map_location=device, weights_only=True)
wrapper.predictors.load_state_dict(ckpt['predictors'])
wrapper.predictors.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
wrapper.predictors.eval()
wrapper.gumbel_mask.hard = True
masks_sig = teal_global_masks(wrapper, calib_ids, 0.7)
sp = _print_mask_stats('Pred-sigmoid-70', masks_sig)
ppl_sig = evaluate_perplexity(model, wt2[:n_eval], device, masks_sig)
print(f'Predictor TEAL (sigmoid) PPL: {ppl_sig:.2f}')

# 3) Predictor-weighted activation magnitude
print('\n--- Predictor-weighted magnitude ---')
accum_hybrid = {}
n_b = 0
for start in range(0, min(16, calib_ids.size(0)), 4):
    batch = calib_ids[start:start+4]
    wrapper.forward_dense(batch, capture_intermediates=True)
    intermediates = wrapper.get_intermediates()
    layer_inputs = wrapper.get_layer_inputs()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for li in range(len(wrapper.predictors)):
            if li not in layer_inputs or li not in intermediates:
                continue
            logits = wrapper.predictors[li](layer_inputs[li])
            sig = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            mag = intermediates[li].abs()
            score = (sig * mag).mean(dim=(0,1))
            if li not in accum_hybrid:
                accum_hybrid[li] = score
            else:
                accum_hybrid[li] = accum_hybrid[li] + score
    n_b += 1
for li in accum_hybrid:
    accum_hybrid[li] = accum_hybrid[li] / n_b
masks_hyb = _global_topk_masks(accum_hybrid, 0.7)
sp = _print_mask_stats('Hybrid-70', masks_hyb)
ppl_hyb = evaluate_perplexity(model, wt2[:n_eval], device, masks_hyb)
print(f'Hybrid PPL: {ppl_hyb:.2f}')

print('\n=== Summary ===')
print(f'Dense: {ppl_dense:.2f}')
print(f'Vanilla TEAL 70%: {ppl:.2f}')
print(f'Predictor sigmoid 70%: {ppl_sig:.2f}')
print(f'Hybrid (sig*mag) 70%: {ppl_hyb:.2f}')
